title: Optional error callback for fetch_all
prompt: Add an optional `on_error` parameter to `fetch_all` in `app/fetch.py`. If it is given and `fetch(url)` raises, call `on_error(url, exc)` and carry on with the next URL; the failed URL is left out of the results. If `on_error` is not given, behavior must stay exactly as it is today. Add tests in `tests/test_fetch.py`. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
